description:
Who we are:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.

WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com 

For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

More about the role:

Are you a communications professional with the ability to lead complex corporate communications campaigns for some of the world’s most renowned brands? At Burson, we’re looking for an Account Director to join our Corporate and Public Affairs team.

As an Account Director you’ll be at the forefront of client relationships, managing a portfolio of high-profile accounts, delivering strategic counsel, and leading projects that impact business outcomes. With a focus on corporate affairs, you’ll drive both proactive and reactive communications strategies, ensuring clients’ voices are heard across media, industry, and stakeholder landscapes.

You will play a key role in leading the day-to-day running of one of our most significant global accounts, working with one of the world's largest aerospace and defence companies, and manage a diverse portfolio of high value client relationships across energy, industrial and wider sectors.

You’ll have a hands-on leadership role, guiding teams, fostering creative problem-solving, and mentoring junior colleagues. You’ll also actively contribute to business growth, identifying new opportunities and driving integrated communication solutions for clients.

What you'll do:

  • Client Relationship Management: Maintain and develop strong client relationships built on trust, leading client meetings and overseeing the smooth running of accounts.
  • Strategic communications: Develop and execute integrated campaigns and communications strategies across high profile issues. You will need to demonstrate persuasiveness and diplomacy to advise clients on complex international communications programmes.
  • Global Team Coordination: Lead and coordinate a global Burson client team working across multiple time zones. Ensure colleagues in different regions work together smoothly, so the client receives consistent, joined-up support.
  • Project Leadership: Manage multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery, high-quality output, and alignment with client expectations.
  • Team Leadership & Development: Lead and inspire a team of professionals, motivating and coaching junior colleagues while fostering a collaborative work environment.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with analysts, strategists, and creative teams to incorporate data insights and deliver integrated campaigns.
  • New Business Development: Identify opportunities to expand client work, develop proposals, and contribute to pitch meetings for new business.
  • Operational Excellence: Manage client budgets, revenue, and resources, ensuring efficient and effective service delivery while meeting or exceeding client needs.

Experience that contributes to success:

  • Proven experience in corporate communications, particularly within an integrated communications agency, working on large, recognisable brands, as part of a multi-market networked agency team.  
  • A track record of advising on communications in regulated industries, particularly those involving complex reputational and geopolitical issues. Experience of the aerospace and defence sectors would be an advantage but is not essential.
  • Strong client management credentials, with the ability to foster long-term relationships and provide strategic counsel on complex communications issues.
  • Strong leadership skills, with experience managing and mentoring large teams, encouraging personal development, and fostering a high-performance culture.
  • Excellent writing and presentation skills, with the ability to deliver clear, engaging, and persuasive communications that meet the highest standards of factual accuracy.
  • Ability to manage client budgets, forecasting, and resourcing, ensuring efficient and profitable project delivery.
  • Knowledge of data insights and analytics, with the ability to use these to shape strategies and provide actionable recommendations for clients.

You belong at Burson:

Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.

At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. description: About us, and our mission At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with a large cohort of patient-derived tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical outcomes, validate therapies and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we aim to make drug development smarter, faster and more personalized. We collaborate with leading hospitals, research institutes and pharmaceutical companies. Backed by leading investors, Orakl is a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of biology, automation and AI. Position overview Orakl runs a high-throughput 3D cell‑culture platform to culture patient-derived organoids (PDOs). These patient-derived specimens reveal critical information into the patient disease, but require heavy maintenance work. Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. This is a high ownership and high autonomy job. You will map our processes, decide what to automate and what to leave alone, specify and source the equipment, negotiate with vendors and integrators, commission the machines, run them with the lab team, and hire the people the function needs. As the ideal candidate, you have already put automated lines or special machines into service, and you know what typically breaks between commissioning and the first experimental runs. While previous experience in biology is a plus, it is not a strict requirement: you will be taught all you need to know. However, you do need a proven experience in working deeply embedded in interdisciplinary teams. Key responsibilities Map cell culture workflows end to end and identify key process automation and optimisation opportunities. Own the automation roadmap. Present and lead the implementation of the major decisions to Orakl’s leadership. In line with the automation strategy you will have identified, evaluate vendors and integrators. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project. Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds. Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests. Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists. Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step. Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly. Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs. Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management. In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer. Key qualifications Must-have Engineering degree (generalist, robotics, industrial, mechanical or process engineering) or equivalent, and at least eight years of experience. Exceptional process thinking skills: you map flows, time operations, find bottlenecks and question the processes. Experience in supplier negotiation and budget ownership on your own projects. Experience in PLC and robot programming concepts, scheduling software, instrument interfaces, basic scripting. You enjoy and are comfortable spending time on the floor with operators. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes. Autonomy: you tell your manager what you decided and why, not what you need decided. Fluency in English is required. Nice-to-have You have put automated lines, cells or special machines into service end to end: requirements, vendor selection, negotiation, integration, factory and site acceptance, ramp-up, budget. This doesn’t have to be in a lab environment : plant, food and fermentation, pharma or cosmetics are other examples of relevant experience. Automation in life-science or regulated environments: cell culture, biotech, food and fermentation, pharma, cleanroom or BSL-2 work. A working understanding of cell culture and what it demands: sterility, contamination risk, variability between samples, and steps governed by the biological pace. Liquid handling, plate-based workflows, incubators and imagers; laboratory scheduling software. Experience hiring and leading an automation team. What we offer You will be Orakl's first automation hire. You will have a unique degree of ownership and scope with a strong mandate to deliver. Short decision lines and fast execution. An interdisciplinary environment with a results-driven culture. description:
About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

 

*** We are open to candidates looking for either a six-month, full-time internship starting in January 2027, or a minimum 12-month apprenticeship starting in January 2027. ***

 

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our EMEA Brand Design team led by Gavin Jones, Brand Design Manager. The team consists of 3 people, including this internship role, working closely with the wider Marketing organisation across the region. Together, you'll be bringing Mirakl's visual identity to life — crafting compelling, on-brand assets that support campaigns, drive awareness, and strengthen how we show up across digital and print channels.
"This is a hands-on team where you'll be involved from day one. I'll be acting as a close mentor throughout your time here, and you'll have real ownership of projects. We check in weekly as a team to review progress, tackle challenges, and share best practices. You'll also collaborate closely with the wider Marketing team and manage incoming projects through Wrike, our project management tool." — Gavin Jones, Brand Design Manager
 

2. Your Impact

  • Design visually engaging assets for digital platforms including social media, websites, and email campaigns, ensuring consistency with Mirakl's brand identity
  • Create and layout print materials such as brochures, posters, flyers, and business cards that reflect our brand standards
  • Contribute creative ideas in brainstorming sessions and support the evolution of Mirakl's visual identity
  • Edit and optimise images for web use, balancing visual impact with performance
  • Support multimedia projects including video editing or animation, as needed
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:
  • Currently studying or recently graduated in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related creative field
  • A strong portfolio showcasing a range of creative work across both digital and print formats
  • Previous experience in a tech company or start-up environment is a plus
Skills:
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
  • Experience with Figma or equivalent UI/UX design tools
  • Solid understanding of typography, colour theory, and layout design principles
  • Ability to produce assets for both digital and print channels
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Wrike
 

4. Tools Used

  • Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign
  • Figma
  • After Effects and/or Premiere Pro (a plus)
  • Wrike
  • AI: Dust, Claude, N8N

 

5. Languages

  • English: professional proficiency required
  • French: professional proficiency is a plus

  • A tailor-made onboarding experience designed to help you hit the ground running
  • Empowering and evolving responsibilities to make the most of your time here
  • A unique opportunity to join a fast-growing French unicorn and collaborate with international teams
  • Access to CSE discounts (ticketing, cultural activities, and more)
  • Gymlib pass to support your well-being
  • Modern offices in the heart of Paris (at the foot of the Eiffel Tower)
  • Swile meal vouchers card
  • 50% coverage of transportation costs (Navigo pass, bike, and more)
 

7. Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.
Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.

description: About BlaBlaCar BlaBlaCar is the world’s leading community-based travel app enabling 27 million members a year to carpool or travel by bus in 21 countries. Our team of 800 employees counts over 50 nationalities and is spread across our 5 global offices, 30% working fully remotely. Your Mission We're looking for a Brand Designer who lives and breathes design. Someone who evolves a brand with taste and restraint, obsesses over craft and detail, and never loses the idea underneath. You'll own brand design work end to end, from concept to pixel to motion, keeping BlaBlaCar's identity coherent, distinctive and alive as it scales. This isn't a ticket-executor role. It's for a designer with an ownable point of view, someone who can defend a creative decision in a room full of stakeholders and make the brand better every time they touch it. The Team You'll join our lean, senior, craft-obsessed in-house Brand Design team, reporting to the Brand Design Lead. We own the brand across every touchpoint, from the refresh being deployed at scale to campaigns and video. We don't separate strategy from craft: for us they're the same act. Internal stakeholders: Growth Team, Local Markets (FR & BR), Product Design, Brand strategy, plus a pool of specialist freelancers. Your Responsibilities Own brand projects end to end: from brief and concept through to polished, production-ready craft, across campaigns and the brand refresh system. Evolve the brand system tastefully: extend and refine our visual language (type, colour, layout, illustration and motion) so it stays consistent and distinctive as it scales. Turn strategy into craft: make work where concept and execution speak the same language, and sweat every detail: typography, composition, grid, consistency. Design in motion: bring the system to life with animation and motion design across social, video and digital surfaces, thinking in movement and pacing, in service of clarity rather than decoration. Design at the forefront of technology: bring AI and emerging tools into the craft tastefully and with purpose, using them to help evolve the brand and serve the work, never letting the tool drive the idea. Partner across stakeholders: collaborate with Marketing, Local Markets and Product, presenting, defending and aligning your work with people at all levels. Keep the source of truth current: maintain guidelines, components and assets, and push new formats and references rather than only running the existing playbook. Who You Are Experience: 5 to 8 years in brand or creative design, in-house or agency, with a concept-led, systems-driven portfolio and a strong visual point of view carried through to finished execution. Design obsession: you follow the studios, designers and trends, and you can say why work is good, with the taste to know when to add and when to restrain. Craft: expert in Figma and strong across the Adobe suite, including After Effects and motion design. Strong command of typography, layout systems, colour, illustration and motion (composition, colour and pacing). AI and emerging tools: fluent with AI-assisted design workflows and curious about what's next, with the judgment to put them in service of the brand rather than the other way around. Autonomy: runs work from concept to production independently, on projects of increasing complexity. Languages: full fluency in English is mandatory. If you don't meet 100% of the qualifications outlined above, tell us why you'd still be a great fit for this role in your application! description:
Introduction 

Variety and the need for agility invigorates life here at Cambridge Consultants. Each day brings fresh challenges as we collaborate to solve pressing global problems and help shape the future of smart homes, connected therapeutic devices, wireless robot networks and much more.  

If you relish autonomy though value the support of passionate, like-minded colleagues, our Software Internship will suit you well. You’ll be surrounded by acknowledged leaders in the very latest technologies as you help evolve our software development for distributed cloud-based systems, rich UIs and agentic systems.  

This internship offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience with software development and the latest developments in technology, while working alongside industry experts on exciting and impactful projects.  

Successful candidates can join us between May- September 2027.

There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.  

 

Your role 

As a motivated and enthusiastic software engineer, you will work on a broad variety of projects. For some projects, the software will be the entire project; for others, it will be one component of a broader ecosystem involving software and hardware developed at Cambridge Consultants or by our clients. We are looking for versatile individuals who can adapt to challenges as they come in.  

You’ll share your days with talented teams of software engineers, UX and service designers, mathematicians, test engineers and DevOps specialists. Your focus will be effective, creative delivery for ambitious, world-renowned clients wanting to make a real difference to real lives. Often you’ll be developing systems that haven’t been seen before and where the specification can at first be unclear. Working with our team you’ll be able to cut through the ambiguity and deliver solutions for our clients.  

 

What you'll be doing  

  • Assist in the development, testing, and deployment of cloud-based applications.  
  • Collaborate with team members to design and implement software solutions.  
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving code quality.  
  • Stay updated with the latest technology trends and integrate new tools and techniques into projects.  
  • Support troubleshooting and debugging efforts to ensure optimal performance of applications.  

 

What you’ll experience while you’re with us

As part of your journey here and to support your growth, you’ll have access to

  • A variety of projects across multiple industries, keeping your day-to-day both diverse and engaging
  • A mentoring and training package shaped around your ambitions, helping you grow exactly where you want to
  • The freedom to pick the tools and processes that make sense for your craft.
  • Plenty of opportunities to have fun and build meaningful connections with colleagues along the way 

 

What you can bring  

We’re looking for applicants who:  

  • Are currently pursuing a relevant degree, such as computer science or software engineering, with good academic results.  
  • Are eligible to undertake a 12-month industrial placements as part of their course. 
  • Have a basic understanding of software development principles and cloud technologies. 
  • Have a strong interest in the latest technology trends and eagerness to learn. 
  • Have good communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with peers and clients to understand their challenges and present thoughtful solutions.

 

Please ensure your CV includes your A Level (or equivalent) subjects and grades, as well as any relevant university modules.

Covering statements are advantageous though by no means a necessity.

You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. description:
At Inceptive, you will help pioneer the next generation of AI-designed drugs, with the potential to positively impact billions of people, as part of a collaborative, antedisciplinary team.

We advance the state of the art in molecular design by training large-scale foundation models that enable cutting-edge generative approaches. Those models learn from diverse biological datasets and are refined through focused experimentation, large-scale training, and feedback from lab measurements. Progress depends not only on building better models, but also on understanding what they learn, where they fail, how data shapes their behavior, and how to evaluate them against biologically meaningful objectives.

You will collaborate closely with AI researchers and biologists to rigorously characterize the behavior, capabilities, and limitations of biological foundation models and their applications. You will identify valuable datasets, develop meaningful evaluations, investigate model behavior, and generate insights that guide model development, data strategy, and experimental priorities across the company.

Your Mission, should you choose to accept it

  • Embody our vision of an antedisciplinary environment and embrace learning about areas outside of your traditional area of expertise
  • Investigate how model performance changes with data quantity, data quality, dataset composition, and training methodology
  • Develop biologically meaningful evaluations and benchmarks that measure progress toward therapeutic design objectives
  • Design and execute rigorous experiments to understand the behavior, capabilities, and limitations of biological foundation models
  • Identify sources of potential artifacts, bias, and noise in biological datasets
  • Identify promising biological datasets for model training and evaluation, and develop computational pipelines for preprocessing, quality control, and exploratory analysis.
  • Design studies, in silico or in the lab, that reveal what models have learned and which biological signals drive model behavior
  • Work with biologists to formulate hypotheses and translate biological questions into measurable machine learning experiments
  • Partner with AI researchers and engineers to prioritize research directions, data collection efforts, and model improvements
  • Analyze, visualize, and communicate experimental findings to inform decisions across teams

Qualifications

  • PhD in computational biology, statistics, physics, machine learning, or a related quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience, with record of publications or open source tooling in these fields
  • Strong quantitative reasoning and statistical intuition
  • Demonstrated ability to identify important scientific questions, design rigorous investigations, and draw reliable conclusions from complex biological data.
  • Experience analyzing high throughput sequencing data (e.g. RNA-seq, functional genomics / transcriptomics, MPRA), with a focus on robust statistical analysis
  • Experience collaborating closely with AI/machine learning researchers or applying machine learning or generative AI tools to scientific problems
  • Familiarity with current AI/machine learning methods, including generative foundation models, representation learning, and model evaluation
  • Familiarity with publicly available biological datasets and data derived from high throughput assays
  • Capable programmer in Python and common scientific computing libraries
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex findings to audiences with diverse technical backgrounds
  • Availability to work with team members across US and Europe, with meetings starting at 8am PT and ending at 7pm CET
  • Readiness to travel several times a year for company retreats and business events
  • We value the benefits of in-person collaboration and expect candidates to primarily work from our office locations

Preferred technical skills

  • 3+ years of post-PhD experience in computational biology, biostatistics, machine learning research, or a related field

Compensation

$135K – $240K + Bonus + Equity

 

What we offer

  • A competitive compensation package
  • 30 days paid vacation per year
  • Comprehensive health insurance for US based Beginners
  • 401K with company match for US based Beginners and Direktversicherung for German Beginners
  • Quarterly company-wide retreats
  • Monthly wellness benefit
  • Budget for multiple visits per year to our offices in Berlin, Palo Alto or Switzerland
  • Learning & Development budget to attend conferences, take courses, or otherwise invest in your professional growth
  • A buddy to help you get settled

*Varies by country and does not apply to internships

At Inceptive, we are creating tools to develop increasingly powerful biological software for the rational design of novel, broadly accessible medicines and biotechnologies previously out of reach. Our team brings together vast expertise in molecular biology, machine learning, and software engineering, and we are all working towards becoming antedisciplinary, meaning we deepen the knowledge we have in our area of expertise while also expanding our knowledge of completely new fields.

We approach our goals with a Beginner's mind, humbly and with fresh eyes, and aim to become the pioneers of a new discipline rooted in biology as much as in deep learning, whose impact will be realized together with out-of-the-box thinkers in business and entrepreneurship, defying established categorizations. We are building a company culture centered around growth, learning, and discovery. We believe in humility and open-mindedness in how we approach each other, as well as problems we don't yet have solutions for.

It is the policy of Inceptive to ensure equal employment opportunity without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, marital status, citizenship, national origin, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. Inceptive prohibits any such discrimination or harassment.

Inceptive is also committed to welcoming and providing accommodations to people with disabilities. Please let us know if you need any accommodations throughout your application process.

description:
ABOUT TIDE

At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.

Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, India, Germany and France.

Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.

Tide facts:

  • Tide is available for UK, Indian, German and French SMEs
  • Over 2 million members across UK and India
  • Over $300 million raised in funding
  • Over 2,800 Tideans globally
  • Recognised with Great Place to Work certification three years in a row, and among India’s Top 50 Best Workplaces in Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance in 2026
  • We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg

ABOUT THE TEAM

You will lead the Client Engineering organisation, responsible for the core health and delivery of Tide’s mobile and web applications. This group comprises Core Architecture, Engineering Productivity, and Quality Engineering. Your mission is to ensure our frontend ecosystem is a competitive advantage, providing the standards and tools that allow our product teams to build with confidence and speed.

You will lead a team of Engineering Managers and partner with a tenured community of Staff Engineers to solve our most complex technical challenges.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As Director of Engineering, you own the technical direction and standards for Tide’s frontend. We are looking for a leader who is deeply engaged in the architectural health of our applications. You will be the primary advocate for a frontend stack that is performant, maintainable, and aligned with our commercial goals.

As Director of Engineering you will

  • Architectural Advocacy: Partner with our Staff Engineers to drive a pragmatic frontend strategy. You will take a hands-on approach to identifying and resolving bottlenecks in our large-scale monorepo workflows, ensuring the codebase remains sustainable.
  • Technical Stewardship & Efficiency: Advocate for the technical solutions that make the most sense for Tide’s business goals. You will evaluate our current stack and workforce model to ensure we are maximising engineering leverage without sacrificing the right tool for the job.
  • Product Virtualisation & Observability: Advocate for systems that provide stakeholders globally with full visibility into the product experience across all configurations.
  • Delivery Excellence: Be responsible for the delivery of a modern Release Engineering model. You will ensure your teams implement a comprehensive automation strategy that prioritises high-frequency, predictable deployment cycles.
  • Emerging Technology & AI: Provide thought leadership on leveraging AI and agentic solutions within the client-side experience. You will explore how AI can optimise frontend performance, automate routine interactions, and drive personalised member experiences.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • Seasoned Leadership: You have led significant engineering organisations and are comfortable navigating the complexities of high-scale frontend architecture.
  • Skilled Collaborator: You can thoughtfully debate technical trade-offs to reach the best outcome for the business.
  • Frontend Pragmatist: You have a deep understanding of frontend best practices. You aren’t tied to a specific framework or a single way of working and instead focus on the best outcome for the business. You have a track record of improving efficiency and modernising mobile release cycles, and you know how to navigate the technical and organisational trade-offs involved in those transitions.
  • Systems Thinking: You naturally see the connection between technical foundations and team velocity. You focus on the system-level improvements that help every product team move faster.
  • Commercial Maturity: You understand that technical strategy must serve business goals. You are comfortable making and communicating trade-offs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

OUR TECH STACK

We use the latest iterations of Flutter and Dart with a modular architecture to build scalable applications. Our stack includes state management, dependency injection, and navigation tools to streamline development. We emphasize code generation, backend communication efficiency, and BDD testing. Monitoring, analytics, and CI/CD are powered by Firebase, DataDog, LaunchDarkly, and GitHub Actions for seamless deployment and reliability.

We use:

  • Frontend: Flutter (Mobile), Angular (Web)
  • Backend: Java (17+), Spring Boot
  • Databases: PostgreSQL, MySQL
  • Messaging: Kafka, AWS SQS/SNS
  • Infrastructure: Kubernetes (EKS), AWS

WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN

Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans: 

  • Competitive Compensation – Competitive salary and share options.
  • Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.
  • Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.
  • Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.
  • Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts.
  • Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.
  • Life & Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.
  • Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.
  • Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.
  • Volunteering & Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.
  • Learning & Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.
  • WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.
  • Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.
  • Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.
  • Snacks & Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.

TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING

At Tide, we champion a flexible workplace model that supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams. 

While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community. 

#LI-AC1 #LI-Remote

TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE

At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We consider everyone irrespective of their ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, veteran, neurodiversity or differently-abled status. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives. 

We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.

 

At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. We welcome all individuals regardless of ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, or disability. Our inclusive culture is key to our success, helping us build products that meet our members' diverse needs. We are One Team, committed to transparency and ensuring everyone’s voice is heard.

description: Einleitung Enterprise Solution Architect (gn) Schwerpunkt EAM-Plattform und Governance Wie oft im Leben bekommt man die Chance, Enterprise Architecture nicht zu reparieren, sondern von null aufzubauen? Die meisten EAM-Rollen beginnen mit einem Erbe: ein Tool, das vor Jahren jemand anderes gekauft hat, ein Repository mit Stand von vorgestern, eine Community, die sich aus Pflicht trifft. Diese Rolle beginnt mit einem leeren Blatt. Unser Mandant, ein international tätiger Dienstleistungskonzern mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden, stellt seine IT gerade organisatorisch neu auf. Die Holding, die alle Geschäftsbereiche steuert, baut dabei Enterprise Architecture Management als eigenständige Funktion auf, mit eigenem Tooling, eigenen Prozessen und konzernweiter Geltung. Tool-Auswahl, Metamodell, Governance: nichts davon ist entschieden. Das wird deine Entscheidung. Solche Konstellationen gibt es selten und sie halten nicht lange. In zwei Jahren ist die neue IT-Organisation gesetzt, und wer dann kommt, arbeitet in Strukturen, die jemand anderes gebaut hat. Jetzt ist der Moment, in dem man sie baut. Worum es geht Enterprise Architecture scheitert selten an fehlenden Frameworks. Sie scheitert daran, dass niemand das Repository pflegt, das Tool nicht mit den Quellsystemen spricht und die Architektur-Community nach dem dritten Meeting einschläft. Diese Rolle verhindert genau das. Du baust die Grundlage, auf der EAM in diesem Konzern funktioniert. Prozesse, die Menschen tatsächlich befolgen. Eine Plattform, die ihre Daten automatisiert bezieht, statt dass jemand sie abtippt. Deine Aufgaben Du definierst, wie Architekturarbeit im Konzern abläuft: Prozessmodelle, Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten, Beschreibungen und Anforderungskataloge. Du wählst das EAM-Tool aus, von der Marktsondierung über die Ausschreibung bis zur Entscheidung, und verantwortest danach Implementierung und Konfiguration. Du konzipierst die Anbindung an Konfigurationsdatenbank, Service-Management und Cloud-Umgebungen, damit das Repository aktuell bleibt, ohne dass jemand es manuell nachführt. Du entwickelst das Architektur-Metamodell weiter, wenn Geschäft oder Technologie es verlangen und misst die Reife der Prozesse regelmäßig gegen Industriestandards. Du probierst neue Methoden aus, etwa Capability Maps oder Wertstromanalysen, und entscheidest, was davon in diesen Konzern passt. Du sorgst für Betrieb und Skalierbarkeit der Plattform, inklusive Rollen und Zugriffskonzepten und definierst Kennzahlen für Datenqualität. Du entwirfst Schulungs- und Onboarding-Formate, pflegst die Dokumentation und schreibst die Leitfäden, die neue Nutzende wirklich lesen. Dein Profil Mehrjährige Erfahrung in Solution- oder Enterprise-Architektur, gern mit technischer Leitungsverantwortung für eine gewachsene IT-Landschaft. Praxis in Einführung und Administration eines marktgängigen EAM-Tools, etwa Ardoq, LeanIX, Sparx EA oder vergleichbar. Sichere Anwendung gängiger Architektur-Frameworks wie TOGAF oder ArchiMate, idealerweise zertifiziert. Erfahrung mit Architektur-Boards oder Communities, und ein Gespür dafür, wie man sie am Leben hält. Abgeschlossenes Studium in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse. Benefits Unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit in einer Konzernholding mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen. Ein sicherer Arbeitgeber! Eine Rolle, die es in dieser Form vorher nicht gab, mit entsprechendem Gestaltungsspielraum. Individuelle Weiterbildung, von Fachtrainings bis Coaching. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Option, mobil zu arbeiten (hybrid). Externe, kostenfreie vertrauliche Beratung zu beruflichen und privaten Themen. description: L’environnement : ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR). Au sein de la Direction générale des services (DGS), la Division des Affaires Financières (DAF) est constituée de 3 pôles d’activités : le pôle recettes & opérations fléchées, le pôle dépenses et pôle comptabilité des matériels. Elle regroupe 11 agents répartis sur les sites de Brest et Palaiseau. Elle est placée sous l’autorité d’un responsable de division, qui est secondé par un adjoint, également chef du pôle dépenses. Le pôle recettes, que vous rejoindrez, est constitué d’une cheffe de pôle, basée sur le campus Paris-Saclay, et de 3 gestionnaires budgétaire et financier en charges des recettes. La/le titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein du pôle Recettes & opérations fléchées, sur le Campus de Paris-Saclay. Vos missions / Activités principales : Sous l’autorité hiérarchique de la cheffe du pôle Recettes & opérations fléchées, le/la gestionnaire en charge des recettes est chargé-e de : Réceptionner et prioriser les demandes de recettes effectuées par les différents services ; Vérifier la qualité des pièces justificatives du titre de recette et s’assurer de leur bonne réception, en assistant les services prescripteurs le cas échéant ; Aide à la mise en place d’un outil de pilotage des recettes globalisées conjointement avec les différents services métiers concernés ; Saisir l’ensemble des données relatives aux conventions et contrats de recettes dans le module dédié du SI Finance conformément au référentiel analytique et budgétaire de l’établissement ; Contrôler la fiabilité des informations reportées dans les états et outils de restitution ; Réaliser les rapports financiers intermédiaires et finaux des contrats de recherche. Veiller à la coordination des opérations avec le service de l’agence comptable pour garantir le rapprochement des recettes de l’établissement et leur régularisation ; Veiller à la bonne diffusion des informations pratiques sur les procédures administratives liées au processus recette et participer à leur amélioration et suivre les dossiers et relancer les interlocuteurs internes ou externes concernés ; Participer au suivi budgétaire des produits en veillant à la bonne réception des pièces émanant des différents services et en suivant les taux d’exécution. description: Company Description We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. We are looking for a pragmatic Global Equity Tax Specialist to join our Tax team. This role is primarily responsible for global equity tax at Checkout.com. You will act as the designated equity tax specialist, supported by the Employment Tax Manager, and will provide practical technical advice while improving the processes, controls and data that support equity activity, payroll, reporting and employee communications. The role sits at the intersection of Tax, Equity, Finance, Payroll, People, Legal, Accounting, Data and external advisers. You will help establish clear ownership, translate technical tax requirements into workable processes, and support the resolution of historic and live compliance matters. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys balancing hands-on technical work with process improvement, remediation, stakeholder management and continuous improvement in a business that values pace, curiosity and better ways of working. Key Responsibilities Global equity tax Act as the key equity tax specialist within the Tax team, providing practical and commercially focused advice on the employment tax treatment of equity arrangements and related events across their lifecycle. Provide tax input into plan design, country implementation, employee events, cross-border situations, liquidity activity, system changes and other business initiatives. Assess the tax treatment of equity activity across relevant jurisdictions, including sourcing, apportionment, withholding, payroll and reporting requirements. Identify when matters can be handled internally and when specialist local advice is required. Monitor legislative and business changes affecting equity taxation, withholding, reporting and cross-border treatment, translating them into clear actions for the business. Payroll, reporting and compliance Work closely with Equity and Payroll to support accurate and timely withholding, payroll processing, payslip reporting, employee funding and downstream reporting. Maintain or support the global equity tax compliance calendar, coordinating returns, notifications, reporting packs, approvals and supporting evidence. Review the quality and completeness of equity tax data used for payroll, reporting, tax calculations and compliance submissions. Identify, assess and remediate historic or live issues, including missing or late filings, incorrect withholding, incomplete reporting, data weaknesses and participant-level exceptions. Support tax authority enquiries, audits, voluntary disclosures and other remediation activity, coordinating facts and evidence across teams and external advisers. Operating model, processes and controls Build and continuously improve the global equity tax operating model, including ownership, hand-offs, escalation routes, service expectations and control requirements. Create and maintain practical country guidance, process documentation, decision logs, filing trackers, data specifications, exception logs and evidence trails. Help develop a scalable and audit-ready approach to managing equity tax across jurisdictions, while maintaining appropriate flexibility for local requirements. Support the design and implementation of system or process changes that affect equity tax, payroll, reporting or employee communications. Stakeholder and adviser management Partner with Finance, Treasury, Payroll, People, Legal, Equity, Accounting, Strategic Finance, Data and other teams so that equity tax considerations are understood early and embedded into business decisions. Manage relationships with external tax advisers and other providers where required, setting clear briefs, challenging advice and deliverables appropriately, and converting external support into practical internal processes and retained knowledge. Develop and maintain employee-facing equity tax guides, FAQs and other explanatory materials, explaining tax mechanics clearly without presenting Checkout.com as providing personal tax advice. Provide clear updates on risks, decisions, dependencies, remediation activity and recommended actions to the Employment Tax Manager and relevant stakeholders. Wider employment tax contribution Support the Employment Tax Manager with wider global employment tax advisory, compliance, risk management and process-improvement priorities where appropriate. Contribute to a high-performing team culture by taking ownership, sharing knowledge, challenging existing approaches constructively and improving how we work. Skills & Experience Significant experience in global equity tax, gained in an advisory and/or in-house environment. Strong technical knowledge of the employment tax treatment of equity arrangements across multiple jurisdictions, including cross-border employees, sourcing, apportionment, withholding, payroll and reporting. Practical understanding of how equity tax interacts with payroll, employee data, finance processes and local compliance requirements. Experience managing or supporting equity tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions, with sound judgement about when local advice is needed. Experience identifying and remediating compliance gaps, including missing filings, historic withholding issues, late or inaccurate reporting, participant-level issues and weaknesses in data or controls. Demonstrable experience building processes, controls, documentation, country guidance and operating models in an environment where responsibilities or ways of working are still developing. Confidence working with data and financial systems, including the ability to interrogate and validate large datasets and use spreadsheets, equity administration platforms, Workday and other reporting tools effectively. Experience working with external advisers, with the ability to brief, challenge and manage them effectively while retaining ownership of the technical position and business outcome. Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex tax issues clearly and influence a wide range of partners. A qualified accountant or tax adviser, or equivalent professional experience. Private-company equity experience would be advantageous, particularly where the role has involved complex data, evolving processes, employee liquidity activity or significant change. Experience in financial services, payments, fintech or another complex, multinational or regulated environment would be advantageous. An interest in using approved technology and AI-enabled tools to improve quality, insight and efficiency. Hands-on, curious and delivery-focused, with sound judgement and the ability to balance detail, pace and competing priorities. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

Our Graduate Analyst Programme

Our Graduate Analyst role offers the opportunity to start and grow your career at Baringa. As a permanent member of our team from day one, you'll work on a variety of real client and internal projects, develop valuable skills, and make a meaningful contribution from the outset.

You'll work alongside experienced consultants, building both your technical and professional capabilities through structured learning, hands-on experience, and ongoing development opportunities. Along the way, you'll build relationships across the business, collaborate with colleagues from different teams and sectors, and contribute to work that makes a real impact.

If you're a recent graduate looking to kick-start your career, Baringa offers a supportive and collaborative environment where you can develop your skills, gain practical experience, and build a successful long-term future with us.

We're looking for Graduate Analysts to join our Capabilities practice, with opportunities available across several of our specialist business units. During the application process, you'll have the opportunity to select the business unit that best aligns with your interests and aspirations.

The business units currently hiring are:

Customer

Imagine a world where customers are delighted, employee engagement soars and costs drop. This is the power of world-class omni-channel experiences. Our expert team anticipates change, crafting innovative solutions that blend seamlessly across all touchpoints. By leveraging cutting-edge technology, we transform service delivery, minimising costs while maximising impact. Ready to enhance your market position and unlock unprecedented value? Let’s redefine excellence together.

Desired Skills: Strong communication, teamwork, and relationship-building skills. Structured problem-solving and analytical thinking. A customer-focused mindset and interest in improving customer experiences. AI and digital literacy with a curiosity for emerging technologies. Adaptability, curiosity, and a proactive approach to learning and development.

Desired Degrees: Business Management, Product Design UX & UI, and Marketing

Enterprise Value Creation

Every organisation faces moments when it needs to grow faster, operate more efficiently or respond to changing market conditions. Baringa's Enterprise Value Creation team helps clients navigate these challenges by combining strategic thinking, analytical rigour, AI-native mindset, and practical delivery expertise. We advise executive leadership teams to identify opportunities, solve complex business problems and deliver sustainable improvements in growth, profitability, and performance.

Desired Skills: Structured problem solving, Data analysis, Digital and AI literacy, Team collaboration and personal communication, Adaptability, Commercial and financial curiosity.

Desired Degrees: Open to all degree types.

Organisation, People & Change

Organisation, People, and Change (OPC) enables organisations to achieve lasting success by putting people at the centre of transformation. With a holistic approach, our team helps clients align their operating models, people strategies, structures, and cultures with their strategic ambitions. OPC ensures organisations are equipped to deliver impact that lasts through an engaged and high-performing workforce.

description:
Overview  

The role of the tester is generally a varied and challenging one, and this is certainly the case at Cambridge Consultants. With projects ranging from short 2–3-month technology prototypes to full scale 18month+ product development, the ability to adapt and move quickly is very important to all our test engineers.  

With plenty of peer support, you will often be involved at the very start of a project, using your analytical and questioning skills to test the various concepts, requirements, and user journeys even before a line of code is written. Working closely with the test and development groups you’ll learn about new products and domains, and you will design and create test harnesses and scripts to thoroughly test the products being developed.  

You will have the opportunity to advance your own skills through our testing community and the variety of projects you will work on. Your skills will contribute to help grow and evolve the group.  

Successful candidates can join us between May-October 2027.  

There is no deadline for this role, as we recruit on a rolling basis. Once the position is filled, we will close the advert. We encourage you to apply as soon as possible.  

 

About the Test Department  

Cambridge Consultants is a world leader in wireless communications, with one of the largest independent wireless development teams in the world. The markets that we address include telecommunications, healthcare, industrial, satellite, consumer and automotive.  

As a test engineer, you will become aware of all forms of testing. You don't have to know how to do all of them, but need to appreciate what is required, be willing to learn new skills and coordinate getting it done.  

 

 

What you'll be doing  

You will be involved in and responsible for:  

  • Performing tests on new and existing projects to become familiar with testing approaches. 
  • Evaluating existing tests for their effectiveness and modify, if necessary, as part of the continuous improvement process. 
  • The scoping, designing, and maintaining of bespoke test harnesses, including test script creation, and the development of continuous integration and deployment pipelines. 
  • Delivery of high-quality code, compliant with our internal coding standards. 
  • Carrying out your specific project tasks within the timescales and budgets agreed with the project manager.  

As a graduate you will be supported with specific training and mentoring and as your experience develops, you will have the opportunity take on further responsibilities.  

 

What you can bring

We’re looking for applicants who meet the following requirements: 

  • A good degree in a relevant field such as Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Physics.
  • Experience of Python (or other languages)
  • Good communication skills, inquisitive nature, attention to detail and a keen interest in technology.  

In addition, experience in any of the following areas would be advantageous (though not essential): 

  • Wireless communications systems
  • Issue tracking systems
  • Familiarity with hardware such as Raspberry-Pi
  • Software development lifecycle
  • Continuous integration tools, such as Gitlab or Jenkins  

Please ensure your CV includes your A Level (or equivalent) subjects and grades, as well as any relevant university modules.

Covering statements are advantageous though by no means a necessity.

You understand that any false statement, misleading information, or material omission may render you liable to disqualification from the recruitment process, withdrawal of any offer of employment, or dismissal without notice if discovered following appointment. You acknowledge that the organisation reserves the right to verify the information supplied.

We speak our minds openly, and with over 400 professionals, including tax experts, developers, and IT security experts, we're rich in ideas and voices. The group has facilitated more than 3.5 billion euros in tax refunds for its customers since its founding in 2016. The opportunity: Taxfix is going AI-first with full speed - and Finance at Taxfix is leading by example: We are looking for an expert professional who will be leading both the transformation of financial processes and implementation of AI in the Taxfix financial systems infrastructure. The focus is on improving our core operational finance processes further through automation and best-in-class practices - and to keep evolving them as AI reshapes what's possible both inside and outside our company and its AI-native platform. This role demands subject matter expertise in finance, technology, and leadership across dialogues with senior leaders, product and technology experts, as well as incumbent finance team to ensure both planning and implementing of the financial systems infrastructure roadmap over time while ensuring resilience, compliance, cost effectiveness, and scalability. Your impact will be visible across the firm including the most senior stakeholders. You'll define and own the roadmap end-to-end, from architecture decisions and change, to hands-on ERP configurations and design decisions, on to bespoke additions and refinements to all financial systems, while further embedding automation and AI into how financial systems and the Finance team operate at Taxfix. As part of this transformation you will lead a dedicated and highly motivated team. This is in essence an architectural role where you are the finance team’s anchor co-evolving the a financial system total that meets growth in product complexity, R&D and infrastructure development, as well as strategic ambition. As such, the ability to sketch out a finance roadmap and implementation game-plan amidst such strategic context and growth ambition is key. This is paired with senior stakeholder management and delivering implementable projects with the day-to-day team. The ideal candidate has a double spike amidst this context: historically a finance professional by training and with first-hand expertise across all core finance processes (order-to-cash, record-to-report, procure-to-pay), followed by years of hands-on finance systems work, automation and ERP experience blending more recently into AI, advanced analytics, business process workflows, and finance transformation projects. Your accounting literacy and sensitivity for audit-ready data and systems are matched by your technical depth. the “other way round” works just as well: a data engineer or leader with a more technological background by training, historically, to meanwhile having transitioned into complex business and finance projects. As such, core finance processes including treasury and financial planning systems with reconciliation procedures are ingrained in your way of thinking and working, and by now you have been responsible for financial systems for years in your current role. You have been delivering results across financial system builds utilizing Precoro, Netsuite, Pigment, Chargebee and Abillify or similar, as well as driven wider best practices across accounting and treasury system transformations, all of which are complemented by more advanced developments of the last 2-3 years around AI workflows, vibe coding, business process and systems transformation put to work. All of these render you a “builder” of the near future at Taxfix: a leader across topic and strategic dialogues for finance with company leadership internally and with strategic partners delivering financial technology to Taxfix externally. Your responsibilities: Map the current finance systems landscape across all Taxfix countries, identify improvement areas, and design the target architecture - owning integration patterns, data flows, and system boundaries across the full stack Drive the transformation of core finance processes through AI & automation and integration of best-in-class tooling across our systems spanning revenue recognition, accounting, treasury, and billing - from vendor selection through to go-live Make AI-powered automation a first-order priority, identify the highest-leverage opportunities across the controllership, and build up integrated core workflows - all of it not as an afterthought Continuously evaluate emerging AI and finance technology to ensure we're always running the best systems available - and staying at the forefront of technology and efficiency Define and sequence the multi-year finance transformation roadmap, balancing strategic ambition with pragmatic delivery, resilience, scalability and cost effectiveness when driving system design decisions and strategy Build a systems architecture that meets institutional-grade standards: robust controls, clean audit trails, and access governance expected of a mature, regulated business while navigating resource allocation for finance systems, source of truth data model, reconciliation paths, API connectivities, all of which in an international setting Co-own the control layers across finance systems incl. month-end close, revenue recognition, and multiple KPIs across all core finance processes Act as the primary liaison between Finance, Engineering, Product, and external partners - translating finance requirements into technical reality Lead system oversight and control across finance systems and strategically govern and document key processes - in particular monthly closing and chargebacks Ensure our client solutions and ecosystem of products are continuously supported by a financial infrastructure that can be considered best in-class with built-in audit readiness Your profile: 10+ years of relevant experience spanning finance operations and finance systems such as billing platforms or payments infrastructure, with deep ERP implementation and change expertise, and proven ownership of technological systems across high-stakes, time-sensitive change projects and workflow automation in multi-entity environments Proven experience integrating, migrating or upgrading ERP platforms with multiple vendors and strategic partners, e.g. with focus on subscription systems - you understand order-to-cash and revenue recognition at a system level, not just conceptually Track record owning AP/AR automation and treasury system implementations, including integration design Genuine fluency with AI in a finance context - you know how to separate hype from leverage and have built automation that stood the test of time Strong controllership knowledge across accounting close, consolidation, VAT, inter-company, and cash management Familiarity with governance and controls landscape, audit readiness and reporting standards of a scaled, institutionally mature organization Builder's instinct: you see fragility in a process and feel compelled to fix it - with systems, automation, or both Professional technical qualifications matter (CPA, ACCA, or equivalent standards in finance - or engineering); strong practical experience and demonstrated results delivery carry equal weight Why this role? You'll own the full transformation arc - from assessing best-in-class against company requirements, designing and planning implementation projects and thereby continuously evolving finance in an AI-driven world where automation handles the repetitive work and every core process runs on best-in-class tooling. If that's the kind of work that gets you out of bed, let's talk. Why Taxfix? A chance to do meaningful, people-centric work with an international team of passionate professionals. Holistic well-being with free mental health coaching sessions. A monthly allowance to spend on an extensive range of services that you can use and roll over as flexibly as you like. Employee stock options for all employees—because everyone deserves to benefit from the success they help to create. 30 annual vacation days and flexible working hours. A generous learning budget to support your personal and professional development and guidance from our internal L&D experts. Work from abroad for up to six weeks every year. Just align with your team, and then enjoy your trip. Plenty of opportunities to socialise as a team. In addition to internal meetups, our international team hosts regular get-togethers—virtually and in person when possible. Free tax declaration filing, of course, through the Taxfix app—and internal support for all personal tax-related questions. Have a four-legged friend in your life? Qualification/Validation : Vous maîtrisez les activités de qualification d'équipements ainsi que la rédaction et l'exécution des protocoles et rapports associés. Qualité : Vous êtes à l'aise avec la gestion des Change Controls, CAPA, déviations, analyses de risques et documentation GMP. Réglementaire : Vous avez une bonne connaissance des GMP européennes et FDA, de l'Annexe 15 des EU GMP, du 21 CFR Part 11, des principes GAMP 5, ICH Q9 et ALCOA+. En rejoignant cette mission, vous participerez directement à des projets de transferts de produits pharmaceutiques, avec un rôle central dans la maîtrise de la qualité, la qualification des équipements et la préparation des installations à leur exploitation. description: Help Us Change the Way the World Works Build something that matters. Langdock exists to change the way the world works, bridging the gap between what technology can do and what people actually do with it. Over 10,000 companies use our platform every day, from fast-growing startups to some of Europe's largest enterprises. Their employees open Langdock to draft strategies, analyze documents, or automate workflows - helping them to work smarter, think more creatively, and reach their full potential. About Langdock Our mission is to bridge the gap between technology and adoption. We build a secure, model-agnostic AI platform that helps companies put AI to work across their entire organization. From chat and agents to integrations, workflows, and our API, we give teams the tools to augment and automate their work. We apply the same ambition internally. We want to be the most productive company in the world, and that means continuously improving how we work, not simply adding more people to existing processes. About the Role Help Langdock understand what drives growth, and engineer the data foundations and systems that make those answers reliable. We are hiring our first dedicated RevOps Engineer (Data & BI) to give Revenue Operations the capacity to own both commercial data architecture and the processes connecting our Go-To-Market (GTM) teams. At Langdock, commercial teams are technical and dedicate ~30% of their time to building. This means frontline workflows are designed and maintained close to the people using them. RevOps shifts focus toward more complex cross-functional challenges: architecting our commercial data model, delivering robust BI, and engineering seamless inter-team processes. Your ownership of the core data domain will create the room to scale growth projects, account handovers, CRM standards, and renewal/expansion architectures. The role combines two core focus areas: ~70% Applied Data & BI: Connect commercial, product, and billing data, build reliable models and reporting, and investigate questions that shape commercial decisions. You will own initiatives from initial business questions through modeling, validation, and analysis, helping teams act on the results. ~30% Cross-Functional RevOps Systems & Processes: Help design and improve how teams collaborate - from lead lifecycle stages and Sales-to-CS handovers to renewal, expansion, and billing processes. Working alongside the functional teams, you will clarify responsibilities, define required data touchpoints, and turn agreements into working, automated systems. Langdock moves fast. This split provides a starting baseline, while priorities will evolve as our product portfolio and commercial organization scale. You will also take on high-impact special projects around growth initiatives and commercial operations. What you will do Architect shared commercial data & BI: Connect customer, product, and revenue data across systems (CRM, billing, product databases, and GTM tools); maintain consistent core metrics; and provide reliable, actionable reporting. Optimize GTM funnels & lifecycle workflows: Define clear cross-team handoffs (e.g., Lead-to-Opportunity, Sales-to-CS, renewals, and expansions), ensuring clean CRM hygiene and minimal friction. Leverage AI and modern automation internally: Use Langdock agents, automation tools, and CRM integrations to eliminate repetitive manual operational tasks and feed internal learnings back into our product. What we are looking for You write clean, performant SQL with confidence and have hands-on experience combining data from disparate, sometimes messy sources into resilient relational models. You treat data with an engineering mindset: you don't just write ad-hoc queries, you build sustainable data workflows, test edge cases, validate outputs, and document your work so others can build on top of it. You think commercially and are curious about what makes businesses grow. You understand B2B SaaS mechanics and distinguish vanity dashboards from data that drives commercial decisions. You have practical experience with CRM systems (such as HubSpot), modern billing data, and automation tools. You build with AI. You have hands-on experience using AI and automation tools to solve real problems and streamline operational work. You can listen to ambiguous business questions from sales, CS, or leadership, translate them into clear technical requirements, and communicate analytical findings with clarity. Our Values Calm urgency. We move fast without chaos. We stay calm, fix what matters, and avoid unnecessary noise. We focus on solutions rather than complaints and make sure sleep, health, and sports keep our decision-making sharp. Ambitious execution. We love building fast and with ownership. We aim to be the most productive company in the world. Learning, shipping, and improving bring us joy. Everyone is expected to ask questions, take initiative, and deliver reliably. Caring ownership. We care deeply: about each other, customers, and the world around us. We act with empathy, sincerity, and long-term thinking. And we have fun along the way while spending time in the office together. The Environment We work from our Berlin office at Greifswalder Straße 212, where all of us work together in person, surrounded by people building AI products and infrastructure every day. Everyone works together in person because the hardest problems get solved faster at a whiteboard than in a Slack thread. Conversations happen faster, problems get solved quicker, and we actually know each other. Days start at 8:30. Lunch and dinner are catered in the office. We look after ourselves, run, go to the gym, and take care of ourselves—gym membership and coaching resources are part of the standard package. Health is not separate from work here; it is part of how we work well. The vibe is calm but intense. No one is yelling or panicking. But everyone is working hard on things that matter. Compensation & Leveling Salaries are transparent and tied to levels, not negotiation. All roles include equity. We will figure out the right level together based on your experience and scope. Levels are about the work you own, not your title or years of experience. We narrow down the expected salary range early in the process. When you apply When you apply, we would love to see an example of a data model, analysis, or workflow automation you've built. Tell us what problem it solved, how it works, and what you learned. Next steps We move fast, and most hiring processes finish within two weeks. If this sounds like your kind of work, we would love to meet you. Who We Are 

At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.

Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions consultancy that partners with organisations from early-stage startups to the world's largest companies. We take on hard software challenges and turn them into durable results. We build agentic products, the platforms they run on, and the engineering and design at every layer.
