If this kind of work and our kind of people energises you, you’ve found the right place.

Who You Are

You’ve shown long-term repeated success on a variety of projects, typically over the course of 7+ years. You can be the go-to leader for any software development engagement. You have a broad and deep range of expertise that allows you to make an immediate impact on projects. In your previous experience, you have:

  • Successfully led high-stakes consulting engagements from discovery to production 
  • Built high-quality, maintainable software collaboratively, incrementally, and through an approach tailored towards the unique needs of the clients you’ve served 
  • Written production-quality code using a variety of languages and frameworks, including but not limited to: Java, C#/.NET, Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Go, Ruby, Scala, R, and SQL

  • Collaborated with teams using Git, MacOS/Linux, and CI/CD
  • Remedied architecture-level concerns such as scalability, security, reliability, and performance
  • Brought together people from different functions and perspectives in forums that encourage idea sharing, collaboration, and problem solving
  • Made thoughtful recommendations and set direction in the face of ambiguity
  • Mentored and shared knowledge with colleagues
  • Actively sought out and effectively given feedback
  • Communicated empathically with stakeholders and colleagues
  • Collaboratively led stakeholders to balance technical considerations with product and user needs

What You’ll Do At 8th Light

As a lead technologist on projects, you’ll work with a variety of clients, typically one to two in a year, through a variety of technologies and frameworks over the course of your career with us. You’ll lead more complicated projects, leading teams to do so. You’ll work with colleagues who share your passion for technology solutions. You’ll invest time developing your skills and sharing what you know. You’ll be responsible for:

  • Making immediate contributions to projects, rapidly building trust with clients
  • Working pragmatically to balance technology choices while delivering high-quality work within deadlines
  • Leading architecture and software design discussions
  • Collaborating on systems that involve the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion and preprocessing, to model deployment, integration, and performance monitoring
  • Generating new potential solutions to challenges (technical and non-technical) in partnership with team members and clients
  • Leading or initiating formal feedback conversations with teams and clients via retrospectives
  • Clearly articulating and documenting outcomes and driving forward action items
  • Contributing to the health of your team and 8th Light’s culture by modeling our Values
  • Ensuring your team has a healthy, prioritized, estimated backlog
  • Managing high-level project roadmaps as the team lead for large engagements
  • Maintaining relationships with client technical leaders
  • Regular syncs with the client to provide status updates, and for identifying and evaluating risks and presenting potential solutions
  • Identifying, mitigating, and resolving blockers to team progress
  • Contributing to 8th Light by serving as a mentor, leading or designing workshops internally or for clients, representing 8th Light in the tech community, or supporting our hiring processes

Strongly Preferred Skills

We work across many areas, and encourage anyone with the experience listed above to apply. We would particularly like to encourage applicants with experience in the following areas:

  • Platform engineering: building reusable software foundations, internal developer platforms, and infrastructure that other teams build on
  • Data Engineering: including platforms like Databricks for data processing and analytics
  • Delivering production agentic systems, including RAG pipelines, vector search, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and n8n
  • DevSecOps & DevOps
  • MLOps
  • Infrastructure as Code

Building a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace is an ongoing journey, and we’re excited to keep learning and growing together. We have a proud tradition of hiring talented colleagues with real-world career experiences. 

How You’ll be Supported

At 8th Light, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Their growth, well-being, and success shape our future. 

  • Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:
  • A robust L&D programme featuring unlimited access to thousands of books, courses, and expert-led training on the O'Reilly learning platform.
  • Annual financial stipend and time allotment for learning & development
  • Coworking support for our global team
  • 12 weeks of new parent leave available for eligible employees

At 8th Light, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that is transparent, fair, and helps us attract and retain top talent in alignment with our company’s strategic growth goals and clients’ needs.

Au sein de l’équipe technique d’Artefact, vous rejoignez une communauté de Software Engineers en tant que Manager et référent technique auprès de nos grands comptes clients. Dans un environnement à forte accélération sur la Data et l’IA Générative, vous intervenez pour piloter des projets d'ingénierie complexes, encadrer les équipes et porter l'excellence opérationnelle et technique.

Ce qu’on attend de vous :

En tant que Manager, vous supervisez la conception et le déploiement d'architectures critiques (Data Platforms, Agentic Platforms) tout en assurant l'encadrement, le mentorat et le développement de carrières des membres de l'équipe. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans la relation client, le cadrage technique des affaires et le rayonnement de la communauté tech Artefact.

Vos missions :

  • Piloter et encadrer la réalisation de projets Data & IA complexes (ex. solutions multi-agents LangGraph sur Kubernetes, architectures Médaillon).
  • Superviser le cadrage et la construction de Data Platforms robustes sur GCP, AWS, Azure ou Snowflake en garantissant l'alignement avec les meilleures pratiques d'Infrastructure as Code (IaC) et d'ingénierie logicielle.
  • Définir la vision technique des projets GenAI / LLM (orchestration, évaluation, contrôle) et promouvoir l'usage quotidien des coding agents au sein des équipes.
  • Assurer la gestion de carrière, le suivi de performance et le mentoring continu des Software Engineers sous votre responsabilité.
  • Mener les cadrages techniques auprès des clients grands comptes et défendre avec pédagogie les choix stratégiques et d'architecture.
  • Veiller au respect des standards de qualité de code, de sécurité et de livrables sur l'ensemble de vos périmètres applicatifs.
  • Contribuer activement à l'animation de la communauté technique (Talks Tech, Guildes, REX) et participer au processus de recrutement et de montée en compétences de la pratique.

Profil recherché :

  • Expérience & Leadership : Expérience confirmée en tant que Lead / Engineering Manager ou Senior Architect ayant déjà encadré des équipes techniques et piloté des projets stratégiques.
  • Résolution de problèmes : Solides intuitions techniques et capacité à traduire des enjeux business complexes en architectures techniques pérennes.
  • Management & Transmission : Posture bienveillante, pédagogique et exemplaire, à l'aise pour faire grandir les talents, donner du feedback constructif et animer une équipe.
  • Spécialisations (au moins 1) : Expertise avérée en Analytics Engineering, Software Development, SRE, Cloud Architecture ou AI Engineering.
  • Stack technique : Maîtrise avancée de l'écosystème tech (Python, FastAPI, dbt, LangGraph, Docker, Terraform, GCP, AWS, Azure, Snowflake, Kubernetes).

Process de recrutement :

  • HR Interview (30-45 min) : Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist.
  • Technical Deep Dive (60 min) : Session de live coding et d'architecture system design avec un Senior Engineering Lead basé en France.
  • US / Manager Interview (60 min) : Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client.

Rémunération : Package :  75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable.

A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

 

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

description:
We are hiring a Machine Learning Team Lead to lead a team of driven ML engineers working on translating cutting-edge research into ambitious, customer-centric speech solutions. 

As innovators in speech technology, our mission is to Understand Every Voice — a vision that has propelled us to be world leaders of Speech AI. Fuelled by innovation, inclusivity, and a passion for making a global impact through world-leading Speech AI, we're looking for an experienced Machine Learning Team Lead to accelerate our efforts towards exceptional speech solutions.

Our Modelling Team builds and trains a broad spectrum of models, including large self-supervised architectures, advancing Speechmatics’ mission to provide the most accurate speech recognition technology worldwide. It also ensures their deployment into production, working with the latest developments in ML, but also with the best practices for software engineering and model serving.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a world-class team of ML engineers through coaching and professional development

  • Provide technical oversight and guidance for end-to-end ML development, ensuring solutions are robust and scalable

  • Guide the adoption of best practices in software engineering

  • Plan work, allocate resources and collaborate cross-functionally to align initiatives with business objectives and bring solutions to production

  • Drive the technical work for the ML team to deliver high-quality technical solutions that achieve ambitious strategic goals

Who we are looking for:

  • Demonstrable experience in guiding and mentoring ML engineers

  • Adept at prioritizing work by impact, feasibility, and time-to-value, with clear success metrics

  • Strong understanding of the modern Machine Learning stack, for example:
    - Knowledge of contemporary transformer architectures, related concepts (e.g., GQA, KV-caching) and best practices
    - Expertise in distributed training techniques
    - Familiarity with optimisation strategies for model inference (e.g., dynamic batching, flash attention, speculative decoding)

  • Proven track record of developing and deploying models at scale

  • Proficiency in Python, ML frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), and experience with cloud platforms

  • Strong familiarity with software engineering practices and ML testing frameworks

We encourage you to apply even if you do not feel you match all of the requirements exactly. The list of requirements is intended to show the kinds of experience and qualities we’re looking for, but it is not exhaustive. If you are interested in the role, the team, and our mission, we would love to consider your application. We are always open to conversations and look forward to hearing from you.

Who we are:

Speechmatics is the leading expert in Speech Intelligence, and uses AI and Machine Learning to unlock business value in human speech worldwide. We work with an amazing mix of global companies, and our technology can integrate into our customers stack irrespective of their industry or use case – making it the go-to solution to harness useful information from speech.

Joining us means working with some of the smartest minds around the world, focused on cutting-edge projects and deploying the latest techniques to disrupt the market. We believe in putting people first; we’ll do all we can to help you develop your skills and give you the tools you need to thrive. Our Focus Fridays give you an undisturbed day of focus, offset with Together Tuesdays when we have our team meetings, so you've always got the right balance.

We have structured a hybrid approach that includes 2-3 designated office days each week. This arrangement ensures that while we embrace the advantages of remote work, we also maintain the vital connection and synergy that only in-person interactions can foster.

This is only the beginning; we’re looking for amazing people like you to continue our journey…

What we can offer you:

No matter what stage of your career you’re at - from paid internships and first-job opportunities through to management and senior positions - we’ll support you with the training and development needed to reach your career aspirations with us. There really is no shortage of opportunities here for you to get involved and collaborate with those around you to deliver your best work.

We offer incredibly flexible working, regular company lunches, and birthday celebrations. But that’s not all. We’ve spoken to our teams to find out what they want. From Private Medical, and Dental for you and your family, through to global working opportunities, a generous holiday allowance and pension/401K matching, we want to make sure our employees and their families are looked after. Every employee will receive a working from home allowance for tech or home office equipment (on top of your choice of laptop and accessories of course). Our approach to parental leave is designed to support employees globally. While this varies by geo, we have support in place for parents (including adoption assistance and reproductive health services) to ensure they have the time and financial resources needed to care for their growing families.

At Speechmatics, our mission is simple: Understand Every Voice out there. 

That's not just about our tech – it's the heart and soul of who we are. We welcome different experiences, viewpoints, and identities. For us, it’s not just the right thing to do; it’s our catalyst for sparking innovation and creativity. Our teams thrive in an environment that celebrates and supports everyone – no matter their gender, identity or expression, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, religion, belief, marital status, national origin, veteran status, pregnancy, or maternity status.

But we don’t just open the door to diversity – we actively welcome it. Why? Because we believe every unique voice adds something special to our team, leading us to smarter solutions and a better workplace.

So, come as you are and join our Speechling community. We’re building a place where every voice not only gets heard but is also respected and valued.

For more information on us, please visit our website and follow Speechmatics on our social channels via Twitter, Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

We rely on legitimate interest as a legal basis for processing personal information under the GDPR for purposes of recruitment and applications for employment.

THG Beauty’s breadth of relationships is unique to the beauty market; it engages with brands as a retailer, a brand owner, and a product developer and manufacturer, making it the industry’s digital strategic leader. 

 
Paid Media Manager 

Leading regional paid media strategy, operational tasks, optimisations and budget management across a range of paid channels and engines, with a core focus on Paid Search (PPC). This role sits at the intersection of performance execution, measurement, and search innovation — ensuring LOOKFANTASTIC remains at the forefront of how paid search is bought, measured, and scaled. 
You will be responsible for the performance of regional paid media activity, with PPC as the primary channel focus. Delivering reporting and insights back into the regional leadership teams. Supporting the Head of Paid Media with strategic input and insights for the wider global approach to Paid Search, measurement, and emerging search platforms. 

Key Responsibilities 

PPC Account Management & Optimisation 

  • Use data-driven insights to quickly iterate and methodically improve results day on day, week on week and month on month. 
  • Own the specifics of account management and optimisation, including campaign structure, keyword research and management, bidding strategy, ad copywriting and testing, search content integration, related search strategies, landing page testing, and any other core capability required to maximise results, drive volume, and hit targets. 
  • Manage daily paid campaign spend to ensure optimum campaign performance against agreed revenue and ROI/COS% targets. 
  • Work with our in-house design team on banner and ad creation for campaign activation across relevant platforms. 

Measurement & Testing 

  • Support the adoption and day-to-day application of our measurement framework, triangulating between Fospha, MMM outputs, and in-platform/last-click reporting to build a rounded view of true performance. 
  • Use triangulated measurement to design, run, and read incrementality and channel tests — translating findings into budget and optimisation decisions. 
  • Help the wider team and regional stakeholders understand where measurement sources agree, where they diverge, and what that means for how success is defined and reported. 

Search Diversification & Innovation 

  • Drive diversification of our search footprint beyond core Google Search — identifying, testing, and scaling emerging search surfaces and AI-driven discovery channels (e.g. ChatGPT Ads and other LLM/answer-engine placements). 
  • Lead adoption of product innovation across Google and other platforms — including AI Max, UCP, and new campaign types and formats — building test-and-learn roadmaps that keep us ahead of the market. 
  • Monitor shifts in search behaviour (including AI-assisted search) and translate these into actionable recommendations for strategy, budget, and creative. 
  • Conduct competitor research and analysis, including how competitors are adopting new search products and surfaces. 

Reporting & Communication 

  • Deliver reporting and analysis that clearly shows the impact of activity, tests, and innovation initiatives. 
  • Provide transparent, insight-led communication back to trading, buying and management teams. 

KPIs 

  • Regional paid media performance, measured against COS%, NC and GP. 
  • Delivery of new campaigns, keywords, and ad copy across all relevant platforms and surfaces. 
  • Successful execution of measurement and incrementality tests, with findings adopted into planning and optimisation. 
  • Pace and quality of innovation adoption — new platforms, betas, and AI-driven search products tested, evaluated, and scaled where proven. 
  • Reporting on performance, with transparent communication back to the trading, buying and management teams. 
  • Driving better revenue volumes within COS% targets, acquiring more New Customers within CAC targets.

  • Initiative — able to think outside of the box 
  • Curious and forward-looking — actively seeks out emerging platforms, products and trends 
  • Organised 
  • Pro-active and positive attitude 
  • Developing self and others 
  • Driven and goal orientated 
  • Passionate 
  • Can build strong relationships 
  • Can work cross functionally across teams 

Essential Skills 

  • Strong hands-on PPC experience across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, including automated bidding and AI-driven campaign types (e.g. PMax, AI Max) 
  • Understanding of measurement methodologies — comfortable working across platform reporting, attribution tools (e.g. Fospha), and MMM, and able to reconcile differences between them 
  • Experience designing or supporting structured testing (A/B, geo, incrementality) 
  • Capability with key marketing platform technologies 
  • Prioritise, structure work and effectively manage time 
  • Excellent communicator — able to give clarity and provide detail on insights 
  • Ability to form good working relationships with internal teams 
  • Critical thinker and problem-solving skills 
  • Project management skills 

Desirable Skills 

  • Exposure to emerging search and AI advertising platforms (e.g. ChatGPT Ads, answer-engine optimisation) 
  • Experience participating in platform betas and translating early access into competitive advantage 
  • Familiarity with retail/e-commerce trading environments and how pricing, stock, and promotion decisions interact with media performance

Who We Are 

At 8th Light, we bring life to the best ideas.

Founded in 2006 and headquartered in Chicago, we are a technology solutions consultancy that partners with organisations from early-stage startups to the world's largest companies. If this kind of work and our kind of people energises you, you’ve found the right place. 

Who You Are

You’ve shown long-term repeated success on a variety of projects, typically over the course of 10+ years. You are a trusted expert and leader, often called upon to guide ambiguous initiatives and architect scalable solutions. You bring a blend of deep consulting acumen, technical expertise, and product thinking that drives measurable and impactful outcomes. In your previous experience, you have:

  • A track record of understanding, assessing, and embracing new tooling and trends within the software industry

  • Collaboratively led stakeholders to balance technical considerations with product and user needs
  • Actively sought out and effectively given feedback

What You’ll Do At 8th Light

As a go-to technologist and strategist within 8th Light, you’ll work with a variety of clients, typically one to two in a year, while continuing to deepen your and our collective domain expertise over the course of your career with us. You’ll be responsible for:

  • Rapidly building trust with clients, demonstrating technical expertise and understanding of their domain and objectives 
  • Driving platform engineering work at the client level, connecting long-term technical vision to what ships 
  • Leading platform strategy and delivery across diverse platform types, connecting long-term vision to what ships
  • Working pragmatically to balance technology choices while delivering high-quality work within deadlines
  • Advising clients on architecture, scalability and platform evolution, connecting technical decisions to product and business outcomes
  • Collaborating on systems that involve the full ML lifecycle from data ingestion and preprocessing, to model deployment, integration, and performance monitoring
  • Driving innovation by proactively surfacing new technical approaches and product solutions
  • Leading or initiating formal feedback conversations with teams and clients via retrospectives
  • Clearly articulating and documenting outcomes and driving forward action items
  • Contributing to the health of your team and 8th Light’s culture by modeling our Values
  • Designing and managing high-level technical roadmaps for large engagements
  • Building your network and maintaining relationships with clients and other industry leaders within your domain
  • Coaching client engineering teams, transferring knowledge and leveling up practices
  • Influencing client CTOs and executive decisions. Planning and execute technical work that involves stakeholders outside of project boundaries such as across a client's technical organization
  • Partner with account teams on planning, opportunity identification, stakeholder relationships, and pre-sales scope shaping
  • Facilitating retrospectives, strategy sessions, and technical deep-dives to improve team and project outcomes
  • Identifying, mitigating, and resolving blockers to team progress
  • Contributing to 8th Light by serving as a mentor, leading or designing workshops internally or for clients, representing 8th Light in the tech community, or supporting our hiring processes
  • Demonstrating leadership in scalable system design, modular architecture, and platform- or product-oriented development
  • Bringing depth in testing strategies, observability, fault tolerance, and secure engineering practices
  • Applying architectural patterns to evaluate tradeoffs and drive clear, documented design rationale

Strongly Preferred Skills

We work across many areas, and encourage anyone with the experience listed above to apply. We would particularly like to encourage applicants with experience in the following areas:

  • Platform engineering: building reusable software foundations, internal developer platforms, and infrastructure that other teams build on
  • Data Engineering: including platforms like Databricks for data processing and analytics
  • Delivering production agentic systems, including RAG pipelines, vector search, and agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, AutoGen, and n8n
  • DevSecOps & DevOps
  • MLOps
  • Infrastructure as Code

Building a truly diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace is an ongoing journey, and we’re excited to keep learning and growing together. We have a proud tradition of hiring talented colleagues with real-world career experiences.

How You’ll be Supported

At 8th Light, we believe our people are our greatest asset. Their growth, well-being, and success shape our future. 

  • Our wellness package is designed with the Whole YOU in mind and includes:
  • A robust L&D programme featuring unlimited access to thousands of books, courses, and expert-led training on the O'Reilly learning platform.
  • Annual financial stipend and time allotment for learning & development
  • Coworking support for our global team
  • 12 weeks of new parent leave available for eligible employees

See our full list of Benefits. 

A Note on Compensation

At 8th Light, we are committed to a compensation philosophy that is transparent, fair, and helps us attract and retain top talent in alignment with our company’s strategic growth goals and clients’ needs.

We benchmark our salaries using Geographic Structures to establish competitive pay ranges within the regions where 8th Lights live. Our pay ranges for our Principal Engineer position within London is: £92,818-£116,122 GBP

Reach out to

8th Light Hubs and Geographies

8th Light's culture is rooted in strong connections that extend across our teams, regions, and beyond client work. We are a distributed team across the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with hubs in Chicago, London, Los Angeles, New York, and Seattle. 

  • London Co-working: Employees working from our London hub follow a hybrid model, which includes a minimum of one day per week in our Waterloo Office. This co-working day is designed to encourage collaboration and further strengthen our community.In most cases, our consulting engagements do not require travel.

We hope to see you apply!

At 8th Light, one of our core values is Honesty that builds trust — and that shapes how we approach hiring. We want you to have a clear picture of who we are, what we're looking for, and how we handle your information throughout the process.

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40
  • 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo
  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success
  • 🏆 Get Things Done:  We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results
  • 🚀 Go Above & Beyond:  We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence
  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

The Team You'll Join

You'll join the Product team of Mirakl Connect, the platform that helps brands and sellers grow their sales across marketplaces and other sales channels. You'll work closely with the VP Product Connect, the Channel Integration PM and the whole Channel Integration squad.

This is a 6-month internship starting in January 2027. You'll participate in team rituals, gain autonomy progressively, and have the opportunity to present your work regularly to management, offering strong visibility within the organization.


Your Impact

Choosing and building the right channels is one of our biggest growth levers. As a Product Manager Intern, your mission will be to help the team prepare and assess new channel opportunities, reduce uncertainty before development starts and contribute to successful integrations.

Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen. Die Rolle In unserer Eigenproduktion bauen wir die Komponenten vor, die unsere Installationsteams beim Kunden direkt einsetzen: hydraulische Cubes und elektrische Unterverteilungen für die Wärmepumpe. Je besser sie vorgefertigt sind, desto schneller und sauberer läuft die Installation vor Ort. Cubes sind unsere vormontierten Hydraulikmodule, die alle wesentlichen Komponenten für den Heizkreis kompakt in einem Gehäuse bündeln. Wir fertigen sie in mehreren Varianten für unterschiedliche Wärmepumpen und Einbausituationen. Unterverteilungen sind die elektrischen Verteiler, über die die Wärmepumpe abgesichert und angeschlossen wird. Sie werden nach Plan in Standardvarianten je Geräteserie und Leistungsklasse aufgebaut. Du arbeitest in einem kleinen Produktionsteam innerhalb von Supply Chain, eng verzahnt mit Lager, Kommissionierung und Einkauf. Die Produktion wächst mit unseren Installationszahlen und zieht 2027 in unser neues Hauptlager in Ludwigsfelde. Deine Aufgaben Montage von Cubes: Rahmen aus Aluprofilen aufbauen, Komponenten einsetzen, Verrohrung in Edelstahl-Pressfitting und Gewinde herstellen, Verkleidung montieren. Aufbau und Verdrahtung von Unterverteilungen nach Bestückungsplan, Stückliste und Stromlaufplan, inklusive Beschriftung der Betriebsmittel. Qualitätsprüfung vor Auslieferung: Dichtheitsprüfung der Cubes, Sicht- und Funktionsprüfung der Unterverteilungen, Dokumentation der Prüfergebnisse. Vorbereitung von Material für die Produktion, z. B. Kabel ablängen, Anschlusssets zusammenstellen, Rohre zuschneiden. Übergabe fertiger Cubes und Unterverteilungen in die Projektkommissionierung, termingerecht zur geplanten Installation. Pflege der Materialbestände am Arbeitsplatz und frühzeitige Meldung von Fehlmengen an Lager und Einkauf. Mitarbeit an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Varianten und Arbeitsabläufe: Rückmeldung aus der Montage zu Stücklisten, Bauteilen und Prozessen. Ordnung, Sauberkeit und Arbeitssicherheit in deinem Produktionsbereich. Dein Profil Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Elektroniker:in für Energie- und Gebäudetechnik, Anlagenmechaniker:in SHK, Mechatroniker:in oder vergleichbare Qualifikation. Erfahrung in Montage, Verdrahtung oder Rohrinstallation, idealerweise im Schaltschrank-/Verteilerbau oder in der Heizungstechnik. Du liest Stromlaufpläne, Bestückungspläne und Stücklisten sicher und setzt sie genau um. Handwerkliches Geschick und sauberer Umgang mit Werkzeug, z. B. Pressmaschine, Crimpzange, Abisolierwerkzeug. Von Vorteil: Qualifikation als Elektrofachkraft, Erfahrung mit Prüfungen nach DIN VDE 0100-600 bzw. DIN EN 61439 oder Grundkenntnisse zu Wärmepumpen-Hydraulik. Gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. B2), um Arbeitsanweisungen und Pläne sicher zu verstehen. Structured Thinker: Du organisierst deinen Arbeitsplatz und dein Material so, dass Abläufe reibungslos laufen. Proactive Problem-Solver: Du meldest Fehler in Plänen oder Bauteilen früh und bringst Verbesserungsvorschläge ein. Team Player: Du arbeitest eng mit Lager, Kommissionierung und Einkauf zusammen. Benefits Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden und profitablen Climate-Tech-Startups. Attraktive und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung. Feste Arbeitszeiten ohne Montage- und Reisetätigkeit. description: Agora Industry Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you! Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries. Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d) Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams. Your responsibilities include Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR). Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks. Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors. Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions. Actively contributing to internal discussions. Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables. As Project Manager, the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication. As Project Manager: At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years specifically in the field of biomass A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies. Solid knowledge of the farming and forestry sectors. Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus. Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus. Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus. Familiarity with sustainable biomass certification and deforestation-free frameworks is a plus. Strong networking skills and the ability to engage with business, industry associations, research partners and policy makers. A creative and result-oriented mind, capable of developing new ideas and proposals with a view to having impact. Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written; track-record in writing high quality documents. description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Account Executive, you'll be the primary connection between GitLab and its customers, working with organizations of up to 4,000 team members to help them adopt and expand the world's most comprehensive platform for software development, security, and operations (DevSecOps), which uses artificial intelligence. You'll own a broad book of business across a wide range of opportunity sizes, guiding small, fast-growing teams as well as more complex projects as they modernize their software delivery with GitLab. Reporting to a Regional Sales Director, you'll run the full sales process: shaping the customer's journey, documenting buying criteria and processes, and maintaining accurate pipeline data based on evidence. In your first year, you'll focus on building trusted relationships and delivering meaningful business outcomes for customers.

What you'll do

  • Own a broad book of Enterprise business, from new prospects to growing existing accounts.
  • Manage the full sales cycle for Enterprise prospects, from discovery and solution alignment through negotiation and close.
  • Articulate the value of GitLab's DevSecOps platform and its artificial intelligence capabilities to Mid-Market prospects and customers, tailoring messaging to their business and technical needs.
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through consistent prospecting, qualification, and advancement of opportunities, using a structured sales process to support your pipeline and revenue goals.
  • Document buying criteria, decision processes, next steps, and key stakeholders to run disciplined, well-orchestrated sales cycles.
  • Collaborate with sales development, customer success, renewals, marketing, technical teams, and partners to deliver a cohesive pre- and post-sales experience, co-sell and close opportunities, and expand GitLab’s footprint while delivering added value for customers.
  • Support customer adoption of GitLab solutions, proactively work to reduce churn and contraction, and participate in quarterly forecasting and territory planning; travel to meet customers and attend events as needed.

What you'll bring

  • Experience selling software as a service (SaaS) solutions.
  • Ability to manage a broad mid-market territory as the primary point of contact, owning a book of business from prospecting through close, adoption, and expansion.
  • Skill in building and maintaining strong customer relationships, including effective discovery, negotiation, and closing to support long-term customer outcomes.
  • Experience conducting consistent outbound prospecting, creating and maintaining a healthy pipeline, and maintaining accurate territory and forecast documentation.
  • Ability to collaborate closely with cross-functional partners (sales development, customer success, renewals, marketing, partners, and technical teams) to coordinate account strategies.
  • Ability to connect customer business challenges to GitLab's DevSecOps platform and communicate its value to different audiences, documenting customer insights and lessons learned; relevant, transferable sales experience from a variety of backgrounds is welcome.
  • Fluent French language skills (required).
  • Experience selling to development or DevSecOps teams is helpful, but not required.

About the team

You'll join the Europe, Middle East, and Africa Sales team, a distributed group of Account Executives, sales managers, and business development team members. We collaborate asynchronously across regions and partner with marketing, sales development, and technical teams.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off 
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

description: About Notabene Notabene is building infrastructure that's transforming how money moves in the digital economy. We're evolving beyond our compliance foundations to enable the next generation of digital financial services between regulated institutions with unprecedented efficiency. With nearly 50 employees across 14 countries and having recently closed our Series B round last November with support from leading investors including Y Combinator, DRW, F-Prime, Jump Capital, Castle Island, and Green Visor Capital, we're looking for people like you to help shape the future rails of the crypto industry. Location: US-based, Remote East Coast The impact you will have Notabene is planning on going through its first external financial statement audit, covering the fiscal years ending January 2026 and January 2027. You will own that process. You will also own the close, the books, and the accounting policy for a two-entity, multi-currency business whose revenue includes subscription fees, usage-based transaction billing, and a payments network take rate that has no clean accounting precedent anywhere. The accounting function is already substantially built. Close runs, the books are in order, and readiness work for the audit is well underway. What we need is someone to own it, finish it, and take it through the audit, while raising the standard on policy and documentation as the business gets more complex. You will be the most senior accounting voice in the company, reporting to the VP of Finance, with one direct report and a set of external providers. You will not have a large team before late 2027, and that is deliberate. Capacity here comes from better systems and better automation, and you will be the one deciding what those look like. Within a year you are successful if Notabene has a clean audit opinion on both fiscal years, with no material weaknesses and no second cycle on auditor requests The close hits its calendar consistently, starting with the revenue close landing on time Revenue recognition is documented in a written memo that stands up in fieldwork, rather than living only in the billing system configuration Multi-entity consolidation and FX translation run cleanly enough to survive audit scrutiny, with intercompany and CTA tied and supported Payroll allocation across departments and software development capitalization are written policy applied consistently, not judgment applied after the fact Key accounting controls are documented, operating, and evidenced At least two accounting processes that are manual today run without a person in the loop, and still hold up under audit What you will be doing Audit. Run the readiness assessment, build the remediation plan, contribute the technical view on which firm we engage, and then own the auditor relationship day to day. Close and reporting. Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close across Notabene Inc. and Notabene GmbH. Produce GAAP financial statements, consolidations, intercompany eliminations, and FX translation under ASC 830. Technical accounting. Write the positions and the memos. ASC 606 across three revenue models, ASC 350-40 for internal-use software capitalization, ASC 718 for stock compensation expense, and whatever emerges as stablecoin payment revenue matures. Revenue and billing systems. Own Tabs as the billing and revenue system of record, including contract configuration, usage data integrity, and the bridge from Tabs to the general ledger. Cost accounting. Build the payroll allocation method for people whose work splits across functions, and the capitalization policy for development work, so departmental margin reflects where effort actually goes. Controls. Design and implement controls over revenue, cash, procure to pay, and payroll. Not SOX. Controls that operate, are evidenced, and can be walked by an auditor. Automation. Evaluate the accounting stack and the processes running on it with a bias toward automation, including agentic tooling where work is rule-bound and high volume. Categorization, reconciliation matching, usage validation, and collections follow-up are the obvious places to start. Accounting operations. Own AR and collections with your direct report, plus AP and payroll accounting. Employee onboarding and HRIS administration sit with People, not with you. Tax. Own US tax compliance in coordination with our external advisers, including the income tax provision and sales tax. Coordinate Swiss compliance with our local accountants. External providers. We produce revenue in-house, our Swiss accountants produce their piece, and our outsourced firm assembles the close. You will own the checklist, the policies, and the reconciliations, so providers execute against a Notabene-owned close rather than holding it themselves. What you bring Experience as a Controller, Assistant Controller, or Senior Accounting Manager at a venture-backed company, with a track record of raising the standard on process rather than just running what exists You have taken a company through a first external audit and can describe specifically what broke and what you did about it Month-end close ownership across two or more legal entities in different currencies Deep, hands-on ASC 606, applied to at least one revenue model without clean precedent, and defended to an auditor You operate in the detail. You build the calendar, do the reconciliations, and touch the ledger Experience developing a small team or a single direct report Nice to have Active CPA license Usage-based or consumption billing experience, particularly Tabs, Metronome, Maxio, or similar Public accounting background, especially audit Software development capitalization under ASC 350-40, including the time capture that makes it auditable Experience replacing manual accounting work with automation, and a clear view on what should stay manual Swiss entity experience, including CHF functional currency and Swiss statutory or VAT exposure Digital assets, payments, or regulated financial services exposure Benefits Flexible Remote Work: Work from anywhere! $1000 WFH Stipend: Use within your first year of employment. MacBook Pro: Procured by you and your manager to find a model that meets your needs. Unlimited PTO: We trust you to take as much holiday as you need. Country-Specific Benefits: Statutory offerings and contributions, managed via our employer-of-record. Apply Today! If you strongly believe this role is for you, please apply. description: Mission Gorilla is the margin intelligence platform for energy retailers. We help some of the largest energy companies in UK, Europe, the US, and Australia understand where they make and lose money, from portfolio level down to individual customer contracts. We are entering a phase where protecting and growing our existing customer base matters as much as winning new logos. Our annual renewals represent millions in recurring revenue, and every one of them is an opportunity to deepen the relationship, expand into new modules, and prove the compounding value of our platform. About the Role Reporting to Tommy Mortberg, our Director of Commercial, you will be the energy trust layer through the sales cycle for the German market. As the sales-focused member of Gorilla's Energy Expert family, you combine deep German energy-market expertise with strong analytical and communication skills to accelerate deals with German energy retailers, turning technical and commercial complexity into a compelling, winnable case for Gorilla. This is a deal-focused, customer-facing pre-sales role. You will run discovery, deliver workshops and tailored demos, build business cases and manage RFP responses on opportunities that need deep product and industry knowledge, then hand over clear solution documentation to delivery. You won't do cold outreach; you come in where your expertise has real impact, and you support and mentor our Sales Engineers along the way. Responsibilities Lead the solution and domain side of complex German opportunities, working closely with Account Executives on deal strategy to grow new ARR. Run discovery workshops with senior practitioners and executives, framing pain in the customer's own commercial and regulatory language. Build business cases and value narratives that connect Gorilla's capability to measurable margin, risk and efficiency outcomes. Own the domain-heavy sections of RFP and RFI responses and help shape the win theme. Work with CSMs and Account Managers to surface new use cases and cross-sell opportunities, driving NRR growth. Ensure smooth presales-to-delivery handover, setting realistic expectations and protecting customer trust. Share patterns from your deals, such as loss reasons, product gaps and German regulatory shifts, with Product and leadership, with a recommendation attached. Support and mentor Sales Engineers on complex use cases and tailored demos, and collaborate with Marketing on insightful content. What You'll Bring German language: Fluent, professional-level German. This role is open to German speakers only. German market experience: Hands-on experience working with German energy providers and expert knowledge of the German energy retail market. Energy domain expertise: Deep functional expertise in energy retail pricing, forecasting and portfolio management. Executive presence: The ability to deliver compelling demos and presentations and build trust from practitioners to senior executives. Commercial, value-based thinking: You connect capabilities to measurable business value and position Gorilla effectively against competitors and alternatives. Consultative approach: An insight-driven, consultative style, with composure and curiosity under pressure. Ownership: You own your prioritisation, turn a clear direction into a plan and deliver it, and thrive in a scale-up. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient. We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today! The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships. Who We're Looking For A research scientist who has led work on world models, self-supervised learning or probabilistic spatio-temporal modelling, and who wants to see it run on real sites. You are rigorous about what a result does and does not show, and pragmatic about getting it into a product. Your Background PhD in machine learning, computer vision, robotics or a related field, with first-author publications at top venues. Research experience in world models, video or latent prediction, self-supervised representation learning, or probabilistic modelling of spatio-temporal data. Experience with anomaly or novelty detection where positives are rare. Strong PyTorch and the engineering to run your own experiments at scale. Nice to Have Scene graphs, multi-object tracking or trajectory forecasting. Bayesian or probabilistic deep learning. Robotics or embodied AI. Simulation for data generation. What We Offer Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end. Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence. Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow. Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team. Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously. In unserer Delivery-Enabler Gilde arbeiten aktuell elf Scrum Master:innen, Agile Coaches und Delivery Enabler an mehreren Standorten in Deutschland. Unsere Mission: Delivery Enablement als starke, zukunftsfähige Rolle etablieren und Projekt-Teams auch im KI-Wandel wirksam unterstützen. Wir teilen Wissen, gestalten unsere Rolle gemeinsam weiter und bringen unterschiedliche Stärken ein. Hier kommst du ins Spiel: Als Delivery Enabler übernimmst du Verantwortung für eine Rolle im Umbruch, führst interdisziplinäre Teams durch den KI-Wandel und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, Delivery Enablement zu einer starken, zukunftsfähigen Funktion weiterzuentwickeln. description:
Moonfare delivers what few others can: the highly sought-after funds and hidden-gem investments that go beyond what most private banks offer. Every opportunity is subjected to a ruthless vetting process; the bar is unforgivingly high. The result? Institutional-quality portfolios for investors who demand more.

Our team combines finance veterans with talent from tech, consulting, law and industries you'd never expect. Headquartered in Berlin, we operate from eight offices across Europe, the US and Asia.

If you're ready to build what's next in private markets, let's talk.

(Senior) Brand Designer

Moonfare is at an inflection point. We are 10 years in the making, with almost €4 billion in AUM and a new CMO recently in place, and the brand now carries more weight than it ever has. We are looking for a designer to make every surface we put in front of an investor look as though it was made on purpose.

The person you are designing for is a partner at Freshfields, a Goldman MD, the principal of a small family office. They read curated material every day and they notice slippage immediately. Our reference points are Loro Piana, Aman, Cartier and Hauser & Wirth — houses that wear their authority quietly and let the object carry the brand. We are a gallery rather than a supermarket, and the craft has to hold at that standard across a fund brochure, a thirty-two word invitation, a billboard at WEF and a single slide in a sales deck.

The Brand Designer joins Moonfare's Marketing team — a high-output team responsible for building the brand, setting standards of excellence, generating demand, and driving investor acquisition across global markets. You will work daily with Fund Marketing, Investor Relations and Compliance, and you will own the craft rather than coordinate it. This role reports to the CMO. 

AI tooling is business as usual in this team — Claude and Figma in the daily stack. The gain we want is not speed for its own sake. It is your hours moving from the mechanical end of production to the thinking.

You Will:

  • Own the craft on every investor-facing surface — fund brochures, the annual letter, invitations, event environments, sales decks, web pages, paid assets — and hold the line on quality when the deadline argues otherwise.
  • Tighten and maintain the design system: type, grid, colour, photography, motion and templates that let non-designers produce work which still looks like us.
  • Design the fund marketing design system alongside Fund Marketing, so that each launch is assembled rather than reinvented, and the material reads like an LP memo rather than a brochure.
  • Take long-form and content design seriously — due diligence summaries, research, the annual letter — where the job is clarity and restraint rather than decoration.
  • Design for physical objects and rooms as fluently as for screens: printed matter, direct mail, gifts, signage and event environments, GTM launches and private dinners.
  • Work inside compliance rather than around it, treating risk warnings and disclosures as a design problem to be solved properly.
  • Bring an AI-first mindset to the production stack — concepting, variation, retouching, resizing and versioning — so that more of your time goes to the thinking and less to the mechanical.
  • Art-direct external partners including photographers, illustrators, agencies and printers, and brief them well enough that the output needs little rescuing.

The Next Moonfarian:

  • You bring six or more years of design experience, with a portfolio that shows editorial and brand craft rather than campaign volume. 
  • You have designed for a luxury house, a gallery or museum, a serious publication or a premium consumer brand — or you can show that you understand that register and want to work in it.
  • You bring an AI-native mindset — you use AI tools in your day-to-day and you have views on where they sharpen the work and where they flatten it.
  • You are equally fluent in print and digital, and you have shipped physical work: something printed, bound, packaged or installed.
  • You bring hands-on command of Figma and the Adobe suite
  • You give feedback as well as take it, and you can explain a design decision to a non-designer without defensiveness or jargon.
  • You can work at pace inside a regulated industry and you see compliance as a design constraint rather than a blocker.

This role is unlikely to be a good match if you:

  • Need a fully written brief before you can start. A good deal of this work begins as a conversation and a deadline.
  • Prefer to direct rather than make. This is a hands-on role and the person in it designs every day.
  • Are happiest producing high volumes of performance creative. Our channel mix is deliberately narrow, and quality of execution matters more here than volume of message.
  • Find restraint frustrating rather than freeing. Our brand is built on hairline rules, whitespace and type weight rather than colour and ornament.
  • Prefer to work at arm's length from the business. You will sit with Fund Marketing, Investor Relations and Compliance constantly.

Invest in Yourself:

  • Ownership and Impact: You are empowered to bring ideas, make decisions, and see your work directly contribute to Moonfare's success.
  • Transparent Environment: We believe in open communication. You will receive regular updates on company strategy, performance against our KPIs, and key business decisions.
  • Personal Growth: We support your development with an individual growth budget of £1,500 or 2% of your base salary (whichever is higher). 
  • Invest in Your Future: We support your long-term financial goals with a workplace pension via SmartPension, where Moonfare contributes 3% and combined employer and employee contributions reach at least 8%. 
  • Relax and Recharge: You start with 25 vacation days and you'll receive one additional day for each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 30 days. Moonfare gifts two days during our annual end of year company shutdown. 
  • Daily Lunch: Enjoy a £12 daily lunch allowance via Deliveroo on the days you're in the London office, delivered or ready to pick up nearby. 
  • Fitness and Wellbeing: Stay active with a subsidised FitnessFirst membership, with £30 covered by Moonfare each month and no joining fee, plus a monthly guest pass and company wellness events.
  • Health Cover: Look after your health with private medical and dental cover through Bupa, including Select Complete Healthcare across 600 partner facilities and Dental Plan Level 2, with dependants covered up to age 24. 
  • Cycle to Work: Ride in tax-efficiently through our salary-sacrifice scheme via Forest, available for an eBike or eMoped. 
  • A Culture of Excellence: Join a team of ambitious, smart, and committed professionals who are passionate about revolutionising private market investing. 
  • Performance Reward: As a performance-first company, we reward strong performance twice a year, so your impact translates directly into how your pay grows — through potential base salary increases and/or bonuses.

Our Values:

  • Our clients come first, Moonfare comes second, and we prioritise ourselves third — Client-Centric Focus. Putting clients first means creating value for them is essential. Placing Moonfare second signifies that our individual professional future at Moonfare depends on the company's commercial success. Prioritising ourselves third reflects our humility in putting clients and Moonfare before personal interests.

About Baringa 

Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.

The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.

Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.

Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.

 

Our Solutions & AI Labs (SAIL) practice are looking for experienced AI/ML Engineers to join the team!

The AI/ML Engineer role will lead the delivery of AI-enabled solutions embedded in our clients' teams, combining deep technical specialism with the commercial and leadership skills to grow and shape our practice. 

This is a role for someone who thrives at the intersection of client advisory, technical architecture and hands-on delivery leadership – and who has a genuine passion for bringing AI solutions to production at scale.  

Our Solutions & AI Labs (SAIL) practice focuses on helping clients control their data, turn it into actionable insights, and better leverage it through the use of AI and Machine Learning solutions directly embedded into business processes. We support clients across a number of industries and offer deep expertise in AI/ML, Cloud, Platform Engineering, and Managed Solutions.  

What you will be doing 

As a Senior Consultant in SAIL, you will own and lead consultancy engagements end-to-end from shaping the opportunity and winning the work, through to delivery governance and team leadership. You will bring SME-level depth in at least one of AI/ML Engineering, Platform Engineering, or Software Engineering, and apply it to create real, lasting value for our clients.  

Although we do not expect you to be an expert in all of the below activities simultaneously, our team consists of people who can work as advisors to our clients as well as bringing deep technical knowledge when needed. The profile of our typical engagements reflects that.  

AI/ML Specialism 

You will bring expert-level knowledge in at least one of the following domains, and working knowledge across the others: 

 Agentic AI & LLM Engineering: 

  • Design and build production-grade agentic systems using major LLM SDKs and agent frameworks; deep knowledge of RAG, MCP servers and prompt engineering at scale. 
  • Strong opinions on secure, resilient enterprise deployment of LLM-powered systems; current knowledge of the latest model capabilities and AI product stacks.  

Machine Learning Engineering: 

  • End-to-end ML lifecycle expertise: feature engineering, model training, evaluation and production deployment, including MLOps, monitoring and drift detection. 
  • Practical knowledge of ML frameworks (e.g. scikit-learn, PyTorch, XGBoost) and cloud-native ML services (SageMaker, Azure ML, Vertex AI). 

 Software Engineering: 

  • Production-grade Python services (FastAPI, AWS Lambda, event-driven patterns) and front-end development with React/Next.js, Material UI and SWR. 
  • Cloud architecture design capability across major providers; rounded understanding of database trade-offs – relational, NoSQL, graph and caching strategies. 
  • Strong engineering practices: CI/CD, testing (Jest, Cypress, React Test Library), release management and security-conscious development.  
  • A genuine passion for AI solutions and specifically for the complexity of delivering them to production at scale. You should be as energised by the hard problems of operationalisation, reliability and governance as by the technology itself.
      

Your Skills and Experience  

We're seeking a technically credible, commercially aware consultant who brings a rare combination of delivery accountability, client advisory skill, and deep AI/technology specialism. You will be someone energised by the complexity of taking AI solutions to production at scale – and who can inspire a team and a client with that same passion. 

  • 1-5 years in technology consulting, software engineering or AI/ML
     
  • SME-level depth in at least one of: Agentic AI/LLM Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering or Software Engineering – with strong architecture and design capability across cloud, data and AI domains.
     
  • Clear, confident communicator – able to make the complex accessible for technical and non-technical audiences alike, and to represent Baringa’s expertise with credibility. 
  • Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science or related discipline, or equivalent depth through relevant professional certifications (e.g. AWS Solutions Architect Professional, Google Professional ML Engineer). 
  • Prior experience as a forward-deployed or embedded engineer within a client environment; exposure to regulated industries such as energy, financial services or public sector. 

If you are excited by the opportunity to lead meaningful AI and technology engagements for major clients and thrive in a collaborative, people-first culture that values both technical rigour and human connection we would love to hear from you.

description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

The Data & Science Org

At Deliveroo we have an outstanding data science organisation, with a mission to enable the highest quality human and machine decision-making. We work throughout the company - in product, business and platform teams - using analysis, experimentation, causal inference and machine learning techniques. We are uniquely placed to use data to help make better decisions and improve data literacy across Deliveroo.

Data Scientists at Deliveroo report into our data science management team, and we have a highly active data science community, with guest lecturers, study groups, mentorship programmes, a robust technical review process, and plenty of opportunities to learn new things. Data Scientists can equally progress as technical leads (individual contributors) and as people managers.

Our data scientists come from all kinds of backgrounds but have excellence in common. Many are formally trained in data science, many are not. We celebrate difference and have a dedicated data science diversity committee.

As an Economist at Deliveroo you will help scale our business and improve the experience for restaurants, riders, and eaters. Using experimental or observational data, you will get to help answer questions like:

  • Which markets/cities should we enter next?

  • How can we incentivise good rider behaviour?

  • What is the business impact of exclusive deals we have with restaurants?

  • Can the Delivery food market sustain multiple players?

  • What are the trade-offs we face when choosing between growth and profitability? How should we decide between them?

  • What is the optimum selection and variety of restaurants?

  • What impact do online reviews have?

  • How will a change in the user interface affect customer choice behaviour?

The work you will do will have a direct, measurable impact on the bottom line of the company.

Requirements:

  • Masters Degree or PhD in Economics or Econometrics (preferred)

  • Always curious and willing to learn new skills

  • A problem solver with a deep analytical mindset

  • Ability to think creatively and insightfully about business-relevant economic problems

  • A critical thinker with very strong attention to detail

  • Proficiency with analytical tools like R/Python and familiarity with SQL

  • Ideally industry experience since the completion of your academic career

  • Excellent people skills — you’ll be meeting with stakeholders to translate business needs into economic problems

At Deliveroo these are just some of the tough problems we are solving - and there is no challenge that cannot be yours. The scope for growth and personal impact is enormous.

Why Deliveroo
Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits
At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.
